data.dax_query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Region],
    'Products'[Category],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Region], 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Order Date Month Start],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Orders'[Order Date Year]), 'Orders'[Order Date Year] >= 2024 && 'Orders'[Order Date Year] <= 2025)),
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Sum of Profit", [Sum of Profit]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Order Date Month Start]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Products'[Category],
    "Sum of Profit", [Sum of Profit],
    "Profit Ratio", [Profit Ratio],
    "Order Count", [Order Count]
)
ORDER BY 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Segment],
    'Orders'[Profit Status],
    'Orders'[Order Date Year],
    KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({"East", "West", "Central"}, 'Customers'[Region])),
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Segment], 'Orders'[Profit Status], 'Orders'[Order Date Year]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Customer Name],
    'Orders'[Customer Tier],
    KEEPFILTERS(TOPN(10, ALL('Customers'[Customer Name]), [Sum of Sales])),
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Customer Name], 'Orders'[Customer Tier]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Products'[Category],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Products'[Sub-Category],
    "Sum of Profit", [Sum of Profit],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Products'[Sub-Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Profit Ratio", [Profit Ratio],
    "Order Count", [Order Count],
    "Sales vs Target", [Sales vs Target]
)

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Running Sales", [Running Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Order Date Quarter Start]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[State],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[State]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Products'[Sub-Category],
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Sales Rank", [Sales Rank],
    "Percent of Total Sales", [Percent of Total Sales]
)
ORDER BY 'Products'[Sub-Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Customer Tier],
    'Customers'[Region Group],
    "Distinct Count of Customer Name", [Distinct Count of Customer Name],
    "Average of Customer Lifetime Sales", [Average of Customer Lifetime Sales],
    "Average of Avg Customer Sales (INCLUDE)", [Average of Avg Customer Sales (INCLUDE)]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Customer Tier], 'Customers'[Region Group]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Discount Band],
    'Orders'[Ship Mode],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Orders'[Ship Mode]), NOT('Orders'[Ship Mode] IN {"Same Day"}))),
    "Sum of Net Sales", [Sum of Net Sales],
    "Average of Discount", [Average of Discount],
    "Average of Days to Ship", [Average of Days to Ship]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Discount Band], 'Orders'[Ship Mode]

EVALUATE
FILTER(
  SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Region],
    'Products'[Category],
    "Share of Region", [Share of Region],
    "Sum of Region Sales", [Sum of Region Sales],
    "Avg Sales per Customer", [Avg Sales per Customer]
  ),
  [Sum of Sales] >= 1000
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Region], 'Products'[Category]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Orders'[Sales (bin)],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('Orders'[Sales (bin)]), 'Orders'[Sales (bin)] <= 3000)),
    "Count of Order ID", [Count of Order ID]
)
ORDER BY 'Orders'[Sales (bin)]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Customers'[Key States],
    'Orders'[Product Code],
    KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({"Technology"}, 'Products'[Category])),
    "Selected Metric", [Selected Metric],
    "Profit per Unit", [Profit per Unit]
)
ORDER BY 'Customers'[Key States], 'Orders'[Product Code]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    "Sum of Sales", [Sum of Sales],
    "Profit Ratio", [Profit Ratio],
    "Order Count", [Order Count],
    "Sales vs Target", [Sales vs Target]
)
